title: Cape Town-based Moment, a provider of digital payments and billing tools for businesses across Africa, raised a $22M Series A, taking its total funding to $55M (FinTech Global)
summary: FinTech Global: Cape Town-based Moment, a provider of digital payments and billing tools for businesses across Africa, raised a $22M Series A, taking its total funding to $55M — Moment, a pan-African FinTech, has closed a $22m Series A funding round led by AlphaCode Venture Partners …
